class.name: WorldDrive
class.brief_description: The filesystem namespace shared by every device in a world, backed by a real directory.
class.description: Paths are drive-relative ([code]notes/a.md[/code]) or use the [code]drive://<world>/notes/a.md[/code] form. Absolute paths, drive letters, schemes and any path that would resolve above [member root] are refused by every method: the drive cannot be made to reach outside its root. Writes through this API emit [signal changed]. The drive is plain files on purpose. Slates, agents and apps all see the same bytes.

method.name: strip_scheme
method.description: Removes a [code]drive://<world>/[/code] prefix and normalizes separators.

method.name: is_valid_path
method.description: [code]true[/code] if the path resolves inside the root (whether or not it exists).

method.name: to_absolute
method.description: The absolute filesystem path, or an empty string if the path is refused.

method.name: list
method.description: Returns [code][{name, path, is_dir, size}][/code], directories first.

method.name: remove
method.description: Removes a file or an empty directory. The root itself cannot be removed.

members.member: Absolute path of the directory backing this drive.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted after a successful write, make_dir or remove through this API.
